invariants.rationale: Drawable#draw requires background to be non-null, otherwise a NullPointerException would occur.
Drawable#draw requires batch to be non-null for rendering operations.
Negative width for a drawing region is unlikely to be valid; graphics APIs generally require non-negative sizes.
Negative height would not make sense for drawing a rectangular background.

invariants.expression: background.draw(batch, x, y, width, height) == null
invariants.rationale: Drawable#draw typically returns void in standard API, so its result ('null' or 'void') is expected.
